question: Does date-vintage US semiconductor producer-price YoY add information about next 21-session SOXL versus SOXX adjusted-open relative log return beyond past SOXX price/variance and leveraged relative performance?
mechanism: Greater received semiconductor producer-price growth may proxy pricing power and improve the relative opportunity to hold SOXL instead of SOXX. This is distinct from failed Fed capacity-utilization level/change, Korea export demand and Cboe option intensity screens.
source_clock: One event signal at 09:46 America/New_York on first Qlib session strictly after each ALFRED vintage date. Use its latest observed month and same-vintage YoY only. No same-day trade, later revision backfill or event-date compaction. First 2019-01-15 vintage has no 12-month comparison and is excluded before outcomes.

event_windows.excluded_gap: 2022-12 release event not trained so every training label matures before first held event; 2026-10 event label not mature.

baseline: SOXX close five-session return ending s-1
SOXX close-return realized standard deviation over 22 complete sessions ending s-1
SOXL minus SOXX 22-session close log return ending s-1
feature_formula.candidate: baseline plus PPI same-vintage YoY percent on this source event
feature_formula.normalization: StandardScaler fit on training event rows only

label: At signal s, adjusted Qlib open-to-open log return of SOXL from s+1 to s+22 minus the same SOXX log return. Require both entry and exit opens finite and positive; label mature at s+22 open plus one minute. This is an information label, not a funded or fee-net account.

model.baseline_and_candidate: two fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0) fits, no weights, no intercept restriction, no hyperparameter search

information_gate.paired_metric: held squared-error improvement baseline minus candidate on identical event dates

stops: Any source/provider hash or event/calendar mismatch stops before market outcome read or fit.
Any missing feature, immature label, duplicate event session or train/held mismatch stops; do not drop rows after seeing outcomes.
No YoY sign inversion, baseline change, horizon/window tuning or resampling adjustment after held scores.
No fee-net SOXX, drawdown, CVaR, annual, rolling or independent-forward claim from this information screen.
goal_boundary: Even a positive information gate is development evidence only; any economic strategy must be separately frozen and pass v2 SOXX 0/2/5bp native accounts, risk, annual, rolling, bootstrap and independent forward gates.
